current_prompt.body:
DETERMINE whether L = {71, 97, 54, 56, 44, 158, 45, 58, 82, 135, 113, 117, 86, 40, 12, 185, 63, 50, 111, 72, 90, 109, 61, 13, 92, 60, 91, 35, 114, 94, 105, 26, 15, 51, 102, 118, 76, 32, 108, 23, 22, 134, 83, 43, 64} can be partitioned into 15 disjoint triples (a_i, b_i, c_i) such that a_i + b_i = c_i for each i in {1, ..., 15}.
NOTE that the list L contains 45 elements and N=15.
IF a valid partition exists THEN EMIT one complete example of the 15 triples.

current_plan.body:
READ the list L of 45 numbers
GENERATE all candidate triples (a, b, c) where a + b = c and a, b, c are distinct elements of L
FILTER the candidate triples to ensure each element of L appears at most once per triple
APPLY an exact‑cover search to select a subset of 15 triples that together cover all 45 elements without overlap
IF a covering subset is found
    EMIT the selected 15 triples
ELSE
    EMIT a statement that no valid partition exists
